name: approdo
description: A booking site for lab user studies, configured from one file (site.config.js) and deployed to Cloudflare Workers with a D1 database.

scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:generic && npm run test:variants

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Required. The password of the admin panel at /admin: at least 16 characters (a long sentence is fine). Until you set a real one the admin panel stays closed.

MAIL_RELAY_URL.description: Optional, leave as it is for now. The address (ending in /exec) of your Google Apps Script mail relay; see docs/posta.md. Without it bookings are confirmed at once and no e-mail is sent.

MAIL_RELAY_KEY.description: Optional, leave as it is for now. The shared key of the mail relay: generate it with `openssl rand -hex 32` (or `node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"`) and paste the same value in Apps Script as RELAY_KEY.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Optional. The address that receives the "someone booked" notices, if different from contactEmail in site.config.js. Only used when the mail relay is on.

TURNSTILE_SITEKEY.description: Optional. The site key of a Cloudflare Turnstile widget (bot check); leave as it is to run without it. See README.md.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Optional. The secret key of the same Turnstile widget; leave as it is to run without it.
